stories.title: Trump Says Colombia Will Accept Deportees, Ending Tariff Standoff
stories.summary: President Donald Trump says Colombia has agreed to accept deportees, ending a tariff standoff between the two countries. The dispute came as Trump made immigration an early priority of his second term, with ICE carrying out more than 900 arrests on Sunday.
